about: Test vectors of canvas's snapping of a model's box to the strokes, R26 in docs/decisions.md: from a submission — the strokes a sheet showed when its work went for checking, their groups (R24; vectors/groups.json) and the numbers of its crop (R25; vectors/crops.json) — and a box in whole thousandths of the crop to the strokes the box takes. A proposal for the eval protocol, epic E3 in spec's RUN.md: the margin and the share are parameters of eval (C2 of the research «Рукопись ребёнка на канве и ИИ-наставник»), and the protocol's own vectors come in spec's releases.

formulas.tenths: every place is taken in whole tenths of a unit, t(v) = round(10 × v), half up, as the groups and the crop take them (R24, R25)
formulas.crop: the crop's numbers, as vectors/crops.json has them: D′ the height its digits are drawn at, its width w and height h in px, its margins [top, left] = [my, mx] in px, B the box of the points in tenths, [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], and H the height the scale takes, in tenths
formulas.place: a point (x, y) in tenths lies on the crop at X = 1000 × ((x − B.xmin) × D′ + mx × H) and Y = 1000 × ((y − B.ymin) × D′ + my × H): its place in px, times 1000 × H
formulas.inside: a box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] in whole thousandths of the crop's height and width, widened by margin × D′ / 1000 px on every side, holds a point if (xmin × w − margin × D′) × H ≤ X ≤ (xmax × w + margin × D′) × H and (ymin × h − margin × D′) × H ≤ Y ≤ (ymax × h + margin × D′) × H, its edges too
formulas.taken: a stroke with k of its n points in the box is taken if k ≥ 1 and below × k ≥ above × n, for the rule's share [above, below]: two thirds of its points at least; the strokes taken are listed by ID, ascending
formulas.sheet: the same as the box laid on the sheet by the crop's sheetBox — x = sheetBox.xmin + xmin / 1000 × (sheetBox.xmax − sheetBox.xmin) — and widened there by H × margin / 1000 tenths, H / 4 at the rule's margin. The box widens first: clipped to the sheet after, it takes the same, for every point lies on the sheet
formulas.strokes: the strokes are those of the submission, of its groups: a stroke written after it is in none of them, and no box takes it
formulas.snapped: snapped is the rectangle of the points of the strokes taken, [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] in units, or null when the box takes none: the mark has no place on the sheet then
formulas.numbers: for a stroke of the submission every whole number above stays below 2^31; an int64 holds every one

cases.name: staircase
cases.about: The research's example: a ladder of two posts and seven rungs, «30» beside it after a pause, «180 : 30 = 5» after another, the 5 erased, then 6, ringed.

cases.name: later
cases.about: «12 + 5 =», and 8 s later «17» right after it: what is written later next to old writing is a group of its own (R06).

cases.name: lines
cases.about: Two lines a cell apart, the second begun 1.5 s after the first, with no pause to think: a group each.

cases.name: signs
cases.about: 3/4 + 1/4 = 1 in fractions over bars, underlined; 3 s later «12 : 4 = 3» below: a group each, with their bars, dots and lines.

cases.name: words
cases.about: Two lines of joined-up words, each word a stroke, with the dot of an i put after its word: a group a line.

cases.name: tutor
cases.about: Two lines as tutor's synthetic writer draws them: digits 36 high, 26 apart, lines 80 apart, 1.5 s before a line and 120 to 249 ms between strokes.

cases.name: crossed
cases.about: A line crossed out at once, 0.4 s after it, which is of its group; another crossed out 3 s after it, which is a group of its own.

cases.name: bridge
cases.about: «12» and «34» far apart, a line under both 0.3 s on, which joins them; «56» and «78» the same, the line 4 s on, which joins neither.

cases.name: undone
cases.about: «12» erased and brought back by undo 3 s on, «3» written next to it 0.5 s after that, the sheet cleared and that undone: «12» keeps the time it was written, a group apart from «3».

cases.name: bounds
cases.about: Pairs at the rule's bounds and just past them: 2000 and 2001 ms, 50 and 50.1 units across, 50 and 50.1 down.

cases.name: rounding
cases.about: Dots in hundredths of a unit and fractions of a millisecond, in pairs. The rule rounds half up: 100.05 units are 1001 tenths, so the first pair is 500 tenths apart across, the fourth 2000 ms apart and the sixth 500 tenths apart down — neighbours all three, which rounding half to even or cutting the fraction off would part. The second pair, 50.02 units apart, is 501 tenths, and the third and fifth come out at the bounds from just above.

cases.name: whole
cases.about: Digits at the top left corner, in the middle and at the bottom right corner: the work is the whole sheet. Its crop fits Claude's standard tier at 32 px, and at 48 px it would not, so its digits come out 32 px.

cases.name: answer
cases.about: A one-digit answer, under the least size of a crop: the crop is 200 px each way, and its margins widen to keep the digit in the middle.

cases.name: limit
cases.about: Three dots that span 660 by 1362 units: no bundle, so the median is 15. At 17 px the crop is 772 by 1568 px, 28 by 56 tiles of 28 px, 1568 tokens: at both of Claude's limits at once. From 18 px up it is drawn at 17.
